messages:
kevin_oncall (SRE): Heads-up — multiple customers reporting 5xx/timeouts for hosted inference in us-east-1 since ~09:12. Dash shows spike in 502/504 and high tail latency. Error rate concentrated on API gateway -> inference pool path. Anyone on network/infra seen this?

anya_support: Getting several escalations — Acme, BrightRetail, and a couple of smaller integrations. Common repro: POST /v1/generate (small prompt) returns 502 or times out after 30s. Example curl from customer: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rwd-13b","input":"hi"}'` -> instant 502 or `504 Gateway Timeout`. Timestamped logs attached via support ticket.

marcus_neteng: Running mtr/traceroute from our edge to inference host in us-east-1a — we see packet loss starting ~AS-Transit edge hop and intermittent re-routing across AZs. Traceroute snippet:
```
traceroute to host (10.0.45.22), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.0.1  0.3 ms  0.2 ms  0.2 ms
 2  provider-pe-1 (34.123.45.1)  1.4 ms  1.8 ms  20.2 ms  !H
 3  provider-transit (34.124.1.2)  25.1 ms  22.8 ms  80% packet loss
 4  us-east-1a-edge (10.1.2.3)  26.0 ms  27.3 ms  50% packet loss
```
Looks like provider edge has flapping/packet loss. Could explain TCP resets -> 502s at our gateway.

jordan_prodeng: Gateway logs show: `upstream_reset: ECONNRESET` and several `recv() failed: Connection reset by peer`. Also seeing 524-like timeouts when streaming hops. Log snippet: 
```
[2026-03-15T09:18:05Z] gateway-01 | proxy: upstream health failed for pool inference-us-east-1a: recv error: Connection reset by peer
[2026-03-15T09:18:12Z] gateway-01 | request_id=abc123 status=502 method=POST path=/v1/generate
```
This matches the packet loss.

kevin_oncall (SRE): Quick mitigation: I'm adding a temporary routing rule to prefer us-east-2 for traffic from the API gateway to inference pools for critical customers and adding a model fallback to smaller local instance until provider stabilizes. Applied policy via router-control: 
```
{
  "route_policy": "prefer-region",
  "conditions": [{"region":"us-east-1","severity":"critical"}],
  "fallback":"us-east-2"
}
```
Applying now, will monitor QPS and error rate.

infra-bot: route-control:policy-update applied by kevin_oncall at 2026-03-15T09:25:12Z :sparkles:

priya_cs: I'm updating the status page (incidents.redwood.ai) and notifying Tier 1 customers. Draft message: "We are aware of elevated API 5xx/timeouts affecting hosted inference in US-East. We're mitigating by routing to an alternative region and will update as we have provider confirmation." Any edits? :speech_balloon:

marcus_neteng: Opened ticket with cloud provider and transit ISP — Ticket 7891123. Provider response: they see increased packet loss on specific provider-to-IX peer and are engaging transit partner. They suggested adding BGP community to prefer alternate upstream for affected prefixes. Also asked for pcap and BGP dump. Run these to collect: `sudo tcpdump -i eth0 -w /tmp/us-east-pktloss.pcap host 10.0.45.22` and `vtysh -c 'show ip bgp 10.0.0.0/16' > /tmp/bgp-dump.txt`

anya_support: For CS: customers asking about credits and root cause. We should collect per-customer request_ids and error windows — attaching a quick query: `SELECT request_id, timestamp FROM request_logs WHERE path='/v1/generate' AND region='us-east-1' AND status >= 500 AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-03-15T09:10:00Z' AND '2026-03-15T09:40:00Z'`. Will paste results into tickets.

kevin_oncall (SRE): Temporary changes so far: 1) route policy to us-east-2 for critical tenants, 2) increase gateway upstream idle timeout from 30s -> 60s, 3) enable graceful fallback to quantized model variant (lower memory) to reduce backend time. Risks: slightly higher latency for fallback.

deploy-bot: rollback:route-config v1.14 -> v1.13 executed by kevin_oncall at 2026-03-15T09:30:02Z

marcus_neteng: Provider updated — they see asymmetric path causing retransmits and are propagating a fix via the transit peer. They estimate stabilization in 20–40 minutes. We should keep the region routing fallback live for 1 hour and then reevaluate.

priya_cs: Messaging pinned. Customers responded positively to the quick mitigation but want ETA and RCA. I'll coordinate a post-incident summary once provider confirms.

kevin_oncall (SRE): Next steps/action items:
- [ ] Collect pcaps + BGP dumps and upload to ticket 7891123 (marcus)
- [ ] Keep routing fallback for 60 mins and monitor error rate (kevin)
- [ ] Collate affected request_ids and attach to CS tickets (anya/priya)
- [ ] Post initial incident update to status page and Slack incident channel (priya)
- [ ] If provider fix not confirmed by 10:15Z, move critical customers to Dedicated/Alternate region as permanent fallback (exec decision)

Ending notes: Looks like a transit/provider level packet-loss + BGP churn causing cross-AZ latency and TCP resets, manifesting as 502/504 at our gateway. Root cause pending provider RCA. Will update when we have pcap + provider confirmation. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
